newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks mostly higher at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks mostly higher at open.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were mostly higher in early trading on Wednesday, but analysts said the Dow Industrials could take a beating once IBM began trading.
Traders said they expected IBM to fall after the company's 10 percent rise in fourth quarter earnings failed to please investors.
The Dow Industrials opened up three points at 6,887. The Nasdaq Composite rose one to 1,378, while the S&P Index was up fractionally at 783.
The 30-year long bond was down 1/32 to yield 6.79 percent.
